game.title: Shadow of the Tomb Raider
game.blurb: Action-adventure in which Lara Croft races to stop a Maya apocalypse in a deadly jungle, from Eidos Montreal, released 2018-09-14. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Lara chases Maya relics through the jungle to stop an apocalypse she helped start. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Tombs, Crypts and Relics
chapters.summary: Challenge Tombs, Crypts, monoliths, artifact collections, Conquistador chests and 100 percent completion.

chapters.title: Exploration, Hubs and Side Missions
chapters.summary: Side missions, challenges, civilians, merchants, outfits, animals, critters, llamas and gold ore.

chapters.title: Combat, Stealth and Skills
chapters.summary: Stealth takedowns, mud walls, Perception, Focus and Endurance, bow and pistol skills, weapon upgrades and crafting.

chapters.title: Difficulty Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing the game on each difficulty, up to Deadly Obsession.

chapters.title: Definitive Edition Extra Tombs
chapters.summary: The extra tomb chapters bundled in the Definitive Edition. All achievements here are hidden.

StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom (tombraider.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://tombraider.fandom.com/wiki/Shadow_of_the_Tomb_Raider
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Shadow of the Tomb Raider" (also missing as "Tomb Raider: Shadow of the Tomb Raider"). tombraider.fandom.com answers the API, with about 180 linked pages, including pages for "The Forge", "The Pillar", "The Nightmare", "The Price of Survival", "The Serpent's Heart", "The Grand Caiman" and "The Path Home"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app is the Definitive Edition (750920); the Steam schema calls it "tr11" (an internal codename). 52 of 99 Steam achievements are hidden. The 36 hidden ones listed after "Completionist" were put in one Definitive Edition extra tombs chapter by schema position; which DLC tomb each belongs to is not in the data, so it could be split later. The other 16 hidden ones sit in the main story chapter; "Beast of Legend", "Unwelcome Guests", "I Believe Hakan Fly" and "Hearts and Minds" sit among side-content achievements and may be optional. "New Heights" (Overhang Climbing Gear) and "Better Equipped" were put in exploration.
